card.name: Dash in citation page ranges
card.fires_on: The hyphen or en dash between the first and last page numbers in a journal reference, right after the starting page number.

modes.label: Page range dash
modes.description: The dash joining start and end pages after a volume or issue number in a reference list.
modes.example: Cancer Causes Control, 2006. 17(6): p. 759<<->>770. PubMed - Ham

card.plain: It fires on the dash between page numbers in a journal citation, such as 759-770.
